projects.name: gstack
projects.summary: Give Claude Code a structured engineering workflow, from product planning to browser QA and release preparation.
projects.bestFor: Solo builders who want repeatable planning and review routines.
projects.limitation: Requires Claude Code and its prerequisites; installation has not been tested here.

projects.name: Emil's design skills
projects.summary: Bring interaction, animation, and interface craft into your coding assistant's workflow.
projects.bestFor: Developers polishing the feel of a web interface.
projects.limitation: Advice depends on the host agent and the context you provide.

projects.name: UI UX Pro Max
projects.summary: A design reference skill for choosing interface styles, typography, colors, and UX patterns.
projects.bestFor: Builders who need a design starting point across platforms.
projects.limitation: Generated recommendations still need accessibility and visual review.

projects.name: Impeccable
projects.summary: A design language and set of commands for critiquing and improving AI-built interfaces.
projects.bestFor: Turning a functional interface into a more considered product.
projects.limitation: It guides a coding agent; it does not replace browser testing.

projects.name: Taste Skill
projects.summary: Guide coding agents toward deliberate art direction, references, and browser-based design review.
projects.bestFor: Builders who want more distinctive websites.
projects.limitation: Follow the project's current setup and browser requirements.

projects.name: Anthropic Skills
projects.summary: Official examples of reusable agent skills for documents, design, development, and other tasks.
projects.bestFor: Learning the skill format or finding a starting implementation.
projects.limitation: Requirements and license terms vary across individual skills.

projects.name: Claude SEO
projects.summary: Run structured website audits covering technical SEO, content, schema, and visibility in AI search.
projects.bestFor: Site owners and marketers who want an evidence-based action plan.
projects.limitation: Some live-data extensions need additional accounts or paid APIs.

projects.name: Marketing Skills
projects.summary: Give an AI assistant reusable workflows for copywriting, conversion, SEO, analytics, and growth.
projects.bestFor: Founders doing their own marketing.
projects.limitation: Supply real audience and product context; verify generated claims.

projects.name: Product Manager Skills
projects.summary: Apply structured product methods to discovery, prioritization, roadmaps, and product documents.
projects.bestFor: Product managers and founders moving from an idea to a plan.
projects.limitation: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 includes a noncommercial restriction.

projects.name: Stop Slop
projects.summary: Help an assistant spot predictable AI phrasing and edit prose into more natural writing.
projects.bestFor: Editing drafts, documentation, and product copy.
projects.limitation: Editorial guidance is subjective; review whether it preserves your voice.

projects.name: Last 30 Days
projects.summary: Research recent discussions across social platforms and the web, then synthesize a grounded summary.
projects.bestFor: Finding current community opinions and emerging patterns.
projects.limitation: Source access, API costs, and available platforms can change.

projects.name: Understand Anything
projects.summary: Turn a codebase into an interactive knowledge graph for exploration and questions.
projects.bestFor: Getting oriented in an unfamiliar repository.
projects.limitation: Useful maps are an aid to reading code, not proof of behavior.

projects.name: Agentation
projects.summary: Annotate elements on a webpage and give a coding agent precise selectors and visual feedback.
projects.bestFor: Design reviews where describing the right element is difficult.
projects.limitation: Requires React 18+; PolyForm Shield restricts competing products.

projects.name: Trail of Bits Skills
projects.summary: Security-oriented agent skills for code auditing, verification, malware analysis, and reverse engineering.
projects.bestFor: Developers and researchers reviewing software security.
projects.limitation: Automated assistance does not establish that a system is secure.

projects.name: HyperFrames
projects.summary: Compose video with HTML and animation, then render it through a workflow designed for agents.
projects.bestFor: Product explainers, launch clips, and motion graphics.
projects.limitation: Generated media or hosted services may have separate costs.

projects.name: Remotion
projects.summary: Build and render videos programmatically with React components.
projects.bestFor: Developers making repeatable, data-driven video compositions.
projects.limitation: Commercial use can require a paid license; check current terms.

projects.name: Brag
projects.summary: Turn a project into a short launch video with motion, music, and accompanying share copy.
projects.bestFor: Builders preparing a quick product demonstration.
projects.limitation: Uses HyperFrames; media services may require extra configuration.

projects.name: OpenMontage
projects.summary: Extend a coding assistant with video-production pipelines, tools, and production knowledge.
projects.bestFor: Assembling a video workflow across multiple tools.
projects.limitation: Hardware and API requirements vary by the selected pipeline.

projects.name: Voicebox
projects.summary: A local AI voice studio for speech generation, voice cloning, and dictation.
projects.bestFor: Creators who want a desktop voice workflow.
projects.limitation: Model performance depends on hardware; check individual model terms.

projects.name: OpenLess
projects.summary: Dictate into another app and have an AI polish or structure the text before insertion.
projects.bestFor: Writing emails, notes, or prompts by speaking.
projects.limitation: Transcription and polishing providers have their own privacy and cost terms.

projects.name: VoxCPM
projects.summary: A speech-generation model family for multilingual TTS, voice design, and cloning.
projects.bestFor: Technical users building their own speech applications.
projects.limitation: Model setup and GPU requirements need checking before download.

projects.name: Browser Use
projects.summary: Build AI agents that navigate and interact with websites through a Python library.
projects.bestFor: Automating browser tasks with a model and a real browser.
projects.limitation: The open-source library and hosted cloud service have different costs.

projects.name: Cua
projects.summary: Computer-use tooling with drivers, sandboxes, and evaluation resources across operating systems.
projects.bestFor: Developers building or evaluating desktop agents.
projects.limitation: Host, virtual-machine, and model requirements vary by component.

projects.name: Odysseus
projects.summary: A self-hosted workspace for working with AI on your own infrastructure.
projects.bestFor: People looking for a central place to use AI tools.
projects.limitation: Review its deployment and provider requirements before setting up.

projects.name: OpenHuman
projects.summary: An agent harness designed to run many agents on modest server resources.
projects.bestFor: Developers experimenting with agent infrastructure.
projects.limitation: Published performance claims depend on workload; not benchmarked here.

projects.name: Ruflo
projects.summary: Coordinate agent teams, workflows, and memory around coding assistants.
projects.bestFor: Developers exploring multi-agent coordination.
projects.limitation: Start with a bounded task; complexity and model spend can grow quickly.

projects.name: MemPalace
projects.summary: Add persistent memory and retrieval to an AI workflow.
projects.bestFor: Users who want context to survive across sessions.
projects.limitation: Benchmark claims are the author's; retrieval quality has not been tested here.

projects.name: Headroom
projects.summary: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and retrieval chunks before sending them to an LLM.
projects.bestFor: Developers managing oversized agent context.
projects.limitation: Savings vary by input; verify that essential information survives compression.

projects.name: Agent Reach
projects.summary: Give an agent command-line access to search and read content across web and social sources.
projects.bestFor: Research workflows that need more than a single search engine.
projects.limitation: Availability depends on platform access rules and authentication.

projects.name: AnyDoc
projects.summary: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, and other document formats into Markdown with a Rust library and Node.js or Python bindings.
projects.bestFor: Preparing document content for AI and knowledge workflows.
projects.limitation: Check the original documentation for supported formats and deployment requirements.

projects.name: TradingAgents
projects.summary: A multi-agent framework for financial research with analysts, debate, and risk-review roles.
projects.bestFor: Developers studying agent-based market analysis.
projects.limitation: Research output and backtests do not establish investment performance.

projects.name: NautilusTrader
projects.summary: Use a Rust-native trading engine for deterministic simulation, strategy research, and live execution.
projects.bestFor: Technical users building trading systems or training trading agents.
projects.limitation: It is infrastructure; strategy logic and venue integration remain your responsibility.

projects.name: Project NOMAD
projects.summary: Bring an offline knowledge library, courses, maps, and optional local AI into one server.
projects.bestFor: Building an offline reference and learning station.
projects.limitation: Content and models need an initial download; storage needs can be substantial.

projects.name: Remotion Superpowers
projects.summary: Add voice, music, footage, and other production tools to a Remotion agent workflow.
projects.bestFor: Creators experimenting with an assistant-led video pipeline.
projects.limitation: Multiple external services may need API keys and have usage charges.

projects.name: Qiaomu SEO
projects.summary: Guide an agent through SEO research, audits, implementation, and verification.
projects.bestFor: Exploring an alternative structured SEO workflow.
projects.limitation: Early-stage project; installation and real-site outcomes are untested here.

projects.name: StemKit
projects.summary: Separate a song into individual audio stems on your own computer.
projects.bestFor: Musicians and creators exploring source separation.
projects.limitation: Model setup, processing speed, and source-use permissions need checking.

projects.name: TradeDesk
projects.summary: Use TradingAgents with local Ollama models in a Windows app, with portfolio context and outcome tracking.
projects.bestFor: Windows users exploring local AI-assisted market research.
projects.limitation: Real-model behavior and Windows installation are listed as unverified in its README.

projects.name: RepoHub
projects.summary: Explore GitHub projects, manage local repositories, connect coding assistants, and try projects in Docker.
projects.bestFor: People collecting developer tools and managing several projects.
projects.limitation: Windows-first; some integrations remain unverified and license text needs clarification.

projects.name: Caveman
projects.summary: A skill and proxy that encourage coding agents to respond more concisely and reduce context overhead.
projects.bestFor: Developers experimenting with shorter agent conversations.
projects.limitation: Token-saving figures are author claims and depend on the task; check that concise output preserves meaning.

projects.name: Awesome Agent Skills
projects.summary: Browse agent skills from official teams and community maintainers across coding, documents, design, and other tasks.
projects.bestFor: Finding the right skill and its original source.
projects.limitation: Individual skills have their own licenses, dependencies, and trust assumptions.

projects.name: MIMIC Code
projects.summary: Community analysis code, derived concepts, and reproducible workflows for the MIMIC clinical databases.
projects.bestFor: Researchers working with MIMIC data and reproducible clinical analyses.
projects.limitation: A clinical-data resource rather than an AI agent; dataset access has separate credentialing and use requirements.

projects.name: REA
projects.summary: Use agents and a shared MCP interface to investigate binaries, application behavior, and runtime activity.
projects.bestFor: Security researchers and developers investigating software behavior.
projects.limitation: Target access, platform support, and supporting analysis tools depend on the workflow.

projects.name: FreeDomain
projects.summary: A domain-registration project with resources for learning practical DNS management.
projects.bestFor: Developers exploring domains and DNS for their projects.
projects.limitation: Supporting infrastructure rather than an AI tool; eligibility, available domains, and service terms can change.

projects.name: Concat
projects.summary: Edit video locally with AI captioning, speech generation, background removal, and an MCP interface for agents.
projects.bestFor: Creators who want local editing and programmatic control in one tool.
projects.limitation: Model downloads and hardware requirements vary; beta features should be checked on your platform.

projects.name: Rakazo
projects.summary: Run persistent AI teammates with conversations, memory, routines, and access to browser or computer tools.
projects.bestFor: People building a self-hosted assistant workspace.
projects.limitation: Bring your own model and execution provider, and review access permissions before connecting tools.

projects.name: MeetNotes
projects.summary: A meeting-assistant project from the catalog's curator.
projects.bestFor: Exploring the curator's early meeting-assistant work.
projects.limitation: Early-stage author project; detailed requirements and real-world behavior have not been independently verified.

projects.name: Awesome Selfhosted
projects.summary: A broad directory of services and applications you can host on your own infrastructure.
projects.bestFor: Finding self-hosted alternatives and supporting services for an AI workspace.

projects.name: Logo Designer Skill

projects.name: Laya
projects.summary: A non-autoregressive decision engine for typed choices, scores, and yes/no decisions across multilingual text.
projects.bestFor: Developers exploring small, structured model decisions.
projects.limitation: Model quality and hardware needs depend on the selected checkpoint and workload; not benchmarked here.

projects.name: FreeVideo
projects.summary: Run a local video-generation workflow with acceleration choices intended to adapt to available hardware.
projects.bestFor: Technical creators exploring video generation on their own machine.
projects.limitation: Early-stage project; GPU memory, supported models, and acceleration requirements need checking in the current docs.

projects.name: Agentic Marketing Team
projects.summary: A collection of AI-assisted marketing workflows spanning strategy, content creation, and campaign analysis.
projects.bestFor: Exploring a team-oriented approach to marketing tasks.
projects.limitation: Early-stage project with limited public adoption; generated campaigns need factual and editorial review.

projects.name: Replica Skill

projects.bestFor: Developers learning through feature and workflow reconstruction.

projects.name: LongCat-Video

projects.name: MangoDisk
projects.summary: Analyze disk usage and manage cleanup, duplicates, applications, and system-maintenance tasks.
projects.bestFor: People reclaiming space for repositories, development tools, or AI models.

projects.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
projects.summary: Generate short videos from a topic using an automated workflow for scripts, footage, speech, and subtitles.
projects.bestFor: Creators exploring automated short-form production.
projects.limitation: Model and media services can incur costs; review factual claims and the rights to all media used.

projects.name: LeronX
projects.summary: An AI image- and video-generation project.
projects.bestFor: Exploring a smaller image and video creation platform.
projects.limitation: Early-stage project; provider costs, deployment steps, and supported features need checking in its documentation.

projects.name: ECC
projects.summary: A collection of agent skills, memory patterns, security guidance, and research-first development workflows.
projects.bestFor: Developers assembling a structured coding-agent setup.
projects.limitation: Choose only the parts you need; host-assistant compatibility and provider charges vary.

projects.name: RuView
projects.summary: Explore spatial sensing, presence detection, and related research using signals from Wi-Fi hardware.
projects.bestFor: Researchers investigating sensing without a conventional camera feed.
projects.limitation: Sensing infrastructure rather than a coding-agent tool; specialized hardware, environment, and validation requirements apply.

projects.name: OmniRoute

projects.summary: A curator-maintained fork of an open-source intelligence dashboard for exploring publicly available sources.
projects.bestFor: Exploring a dashboard for publicly available intelligence sources.
projects.limitation: An upstream fork with limited adoption; verify source reliability, upstream credits, and license obligations before use.

projects.name: Recordly
projects.summary: Create polished screen recordings and product-demo videos with less manual editing.
projects.bestFor: Builders documenting a product or preparing a demonstration.
projects.limitation: A supporting recording tool rather than an AI agent; platform and export support should be checked in the current release.

projects.summary: Connect multiple LLM providers through a shared OpenAI-compatible endpoint with routing and automatic fallback.
